data.name: Number Factory
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Number Factory - where numbers are your business, and infinity is just the beginning.

Manage a cutting-edge facility dedicated to one purpose: producing the biggest numbers in the universe. Start small, automate everything, and watch your production soar to unimaginable heights.

🏭 Core Gameplay

Pure Idle Progression - Your factory never stops working. Generators automatically produce numbers every second, even while you're away. Return to massive offline earnings and keep pushing toward the next milestone.

Strategic Upgrades - Invest your numbers wisely in generators and multipliers. Each purchase compounds your growth, creating satisfying exponential progression that rewards smart planning.

Prestige System - Hit your limit? Reset everything for powerful Prestige Points and Formula Energy. Unlock permanent bonuses that make each run faster and more rewarding than the last.

✨ Key Features

🌳 Extensive Prestige Tree

Unlock dozens of powerful permanent upgrades across a sprawling prestige tree. Each node opens new strategies and multiplies your potential. Will you focus on raw production, prestige point gain, or unlock game-changing

mechanics?

🎯 Challenge System

Test your skills with special challenge modes that restrict your abilities for massive rewards. Complete challenges to unlock unique bonuses and prove your mastery.

🏆 Achievement Hunter's Paradise

Track your progress with comprehensive achievements. From your first million to your billionth prestige, every milestone is celebrated with rewards and bragging rights.

💎 Crystal Economy

Earn premium Crystals through gameplay and compete for monthly rankings. Spend them on powerful production multipliers or quality-of-life upgrades in the shop.

📊 Global Leaderboards

Compete with players worldwide across multiple categories:

- Highest Numbers - Who can reach the biggest number?

- Most Prestiges - Speed and optimization mastery

- Total Purchases - Complete dedication to the factory

Monthly seasons keep competition fresh and give everyone a chance to climb the ranks.

🎮 Skills & Specialization

Unlock and upgrade skills that define your playstyle. Boost production, increase prestige gains, or unlock powerful automation features.

📈 Deep Statistics

Track everything from total playtime to production rates. Analyze your progress with detailed statistics and personal records. Every number tells a story.

🛒 Shop & Boosts

Purchase permanent production multipliers, crystal packs, and supporter packs. All production boosts include bonus crystals and stack multiplicatively for exponential power.

🎨 Features

✅ Satisfying Number Growth - Watch numbers climb from single digits to values with dozens of zeros

✅ Beautiful UI - Clean, modern interface designed for clarity and ease of use

✅ Smart Notation - Automatic formatting from thousands (1.5K) to vigintillions (1.5Vg) and beyond

✅ Offline Progress - Keep earning even when you're not playing

✅ Regular Updates - New content, features, and improvements

✅ Achievement System - Hundreds of goals to complete

✅ Cloud Saves - Never lose your progress (Steam Cloud)

✅ No Forced Ads - Pure, uninterrupted gameplay experience

🚀 Perfect For

- Fans of idle and incremental games

- Players who love optimization and strategy

- Achievement hunters and completionists

- Anyone who enjoys watching numbers grow

- Casual players looking for a relaxing experience

- Hardcore players seeking deep meta-progression

📱 Gameplay Loop

1. Generate - Passive production creates numbers automatically

2. Upgrade - Purchase generators and multipliers to boost production

3. Prestige - Reset for permanent bonuses when growth slows

4. Unlock - Expand your prestige tree and unlock new mechanics

5. Compete - Climb global leaderboards and complete challenges

6. Repeat - Each cycle is faster and more rewarding than the last

🎯 From Zero to Infinity

Start with a single generator producing 1 number per second. End with dozens of maxed generators producing numbers so large they require scientific notation just to display. The journey from humble beginnings to

mathematical godhood is filled with satisfying milestones, strategic decisions, and exponential growth.

Every second counts. Every upgrade matters. Every prestige makes you stronger.

🎮 Start Your Number Empire Today

The factory awaits. How high can you go?

data.short_description: Build the ultimate number production empire! Automate generators, unlock powerful upgrades, and prestige for permanent bonuses. Compete on global leaderboards and watch your numbers grow to infinity in this addictive idle incremental game.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 or later
  • Processor: 1.5 GHz dual-core
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics card
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 2.0 GHz dual-core or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated graphics card
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
